Test constant_shape_512 first: it keeps the existing transpose, fallback, and tile arithmetic, which limits correctness risk, though it may duplicate work the compiler already specializes. Test cache_conflict_layout second: padding could change cache behavior, but requires coordinated packing, stride, rewind, and allocation changes; the cache-conflict benefit is speculative and address errors carry greater risk. The measured sixteen-panel helper path did not show a repeatable gain over paired controls, so it does not support prioritizing another packing-layout change.
